## Description

A clear and concise description of the PR.

Use this section for review hints, explanations, or discussion
points/todos.

## Ticket

Link or number of the related issue/ticket, if any.

## Changes

Summary of what changed.

## Notes

Reasoning, additional context, anything a reviewer should know that
isn't obvious from the diff.

## Screenshots

Screenshots or a screen recording of any visual changes.

(Delete this section if there's nothing visual to show.)

## Docs

Any notes that help document the feature/change. Doesn't need to be
polished — a few words or a code snippet is enough.

## Checklist

- [ ] Manually tested
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated (if applicable)
